title: Modified Scattering for the Time-Dependent Kohn--Sham Equation
summary: We study the long-time behavior of the (critical) Kohn--Sham equation in two and three dimensions, i.e.,\[ \mathrm{i} \partial_t γ = \Big[-\frac{1}{2}Δ+ λ\, |\cdot|^{-1} \ast ρ_{γ} + μ\, ρ_{γ}^{1/d}, γ \Big] \quad \text{for} \quad d=2,3. \] By introducing a suitable ''square root'' of the density matrix and exploiting the pseudo-conformal transform, we establish global well-posedness for small initial data in an appropriate weighted Schatten norm.
